title: Ontology-aware neural network predicts antibiotic resistance genes in metagenomes
summary: ONN4ARG, an ontology-aware neural network, was applied to 200 million candidate microbial genes from 815 community samples and returned 120,726 candidate antibiotic resistance genes, over 20% of which were absent from public databases. Wet-lab functional validation together with structural docking-site investigation confirmed a novel streptomycin resistance gene from oral microbiome samples. Only one gene is reported as experimentally confirmed. Preprint of 2021-07-31.
ai_technology: Ontology-aware neural network (ONN4ARG) predicting antibiotic resistance genes from metagenomic data
organization: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

evidence.tested: Wet-lab functional validation and structural docking-site analysis of one novel streptomycin resistance gene.
evidence.unknown: The correctness of the remaining candidate genes is not established; abstract-level review; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A neural network predicted and prioritized antibiotic resistance genes, including the novel gene that was tested.
